name: auto-claude
description: Experimental (2026-11-18, F128; K5 in docs/25-cascade-research.md): one preset that picks the path per request with no model call. A trivial or small self-contained request: Claude Haiku 5.5 alone. A new program or a large, many-part request: Claude Opus 5.5 plans with acceptance cases and a test file, Haiku, Claude Sonnet 5.5 or itself build against it (K2). A bug or change in an existing repository: Haiku scouts and reproduces, Opus writes the patch in one call (K1). Opus never runs a tool session after a cheaper developer is stuck.
